hook.name: Hive
hook.description: ERC-20 token that doubles as its own Uniswap v4 hook, charging a 0.5% buy tax (taken in HIVE and converted to ETH) and a 1% sell tax (taken in ETH directly) via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Tax proceeds accumulate in a shared jar distributed to holders who did not sell when net sell pressure exhausts a strength buffer, triggering a round collapse and payout.
